title: TV HUD READABILITY
why: The clean two-window TV pictures scored 3. The large belt looked like a solid wall of empty tiles and the score labels were small and pressed against the top edge. Raid vacant keys now keep only quiet silhouettes and outlined key digits, while owned keys keep flat plates, 3px rarity rails and the owner-required gold ring. Raid belt text starts at 18px and grows with TV scale; the TV belt moves 12 logical pixels closer to the bottom corners. Vitals keep the owner-requested larger hp bar and gain ink outlines for contrast. Score labels use the label role, the panel has a 16px top inset and the extraction pill has an 8px gap. Playtest watch: check belt selection and ammo states, the final-minute clock and long score totals in both windows; check tv belt clicks after resizing panels. No world or feel values changed.
now: TV HUD labels read larger; empty belt slots are quieter and the score panel has room.
